title: Ancient Constantine Bridge Emerges from the Danube Near Bulgaria
description: Ancient remains of Constantine the Great's Bridge have emerged from the Danube near the Bulgarian village of Gigen after exceptionally low river levels exposed parts of the Roman structure, offering archaeologists a rare chance to study one of antiquity's greatest engineering achievements. The unusually low water levels are the result of prolonged drought caused by a series of record-breaking heat waves across Europe this summer. The extreme weather has significantly affected major rivers, including the Danube and the Rhine, exposing archaeological sites that are normally hidden beneath the water. ...
